blockers.detail: ADI is a closure-first candidate with valid Scout evidence and primary issuer lineage, but its current packet has no Alpha source-integrity/company-underwriting perspectives and no scoreRecord. The available cumulative evidence is one issuer-origin FY26Q3 disclosure duplicated across Scout perspectives. It does not source-address all 12 methodology 1.0.0 numeric factors, risk evidence, data-confidence evidence, governance, current valuation, or supply-chain resilience. Emitting numeric values would violate the BEAST-EVIDENCE contract.
